records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.chart_reading: 5 项中最高是 Australia(53,303.40),其次 China(47,858.51),最低 Spain(21,021.39),最高约为最低的 2.5 倍。
records.sql:
SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 三个商品大类各自的销售额和总利润是多少?
records.chart_reading: 3 项中最高是 Technology(756,983.02),其次 Furniture(598,238.22),最低 Office Supplies(352,496.14),最高约为最低的 2.1 倍。按 总利润 计,最高是 Technology(145,068.68)。
records.sql:
SELECT p.category AS 商品大类,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS 销售额,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS 总利润
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

records.tags: 多表/聚合/时间/枚举陷阱
records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

records.question: 平均折扣最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?

records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category AS 子类,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.discount), 4) AS 平均折扣率,
       COUNT(*) AS 明细行数
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY AVG(oi.discount) DESC
LIMIT 3

records.question: 2014 年每个季度的销售额分别是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1 AS quarter,
       SUM(i.sales) AS total_sales
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter

       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) IN ('2013', '2014')
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', o.order_date)
ORDER BY year;

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.chart_reading: 3 项中最高是 Paper(806.32),其次 Fasteners(246.47),最低 Labels(21.86),最高约为最低的 36.9 倍。按 total_sales 计,最高是 Paper(1,816.57)。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) * 1.0 / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC
LIMIT 3;

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?
records.chart_reading: 5 项中最高是 Chairs(23,245.88),其次 Tables(13,051.69),最低 Supplies(-89.85)。按 total_sales 计,最高是 Chairs(179,648.44)。其中有 1 项为负值,如实画出。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category,
       SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit,
       SUM(oi.sales)  AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) * 1.0 / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin ASC
LIMIT 5

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_order_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.sales) AS amount
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate'
    AND o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2014-12-31'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
)

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales
FROM (
  SELECT sales
  FROM order_items
  WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY sales
  LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL) % 2
  OFFSET ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL) - 1) / 2
)

records.question: 按配送方式统计总销售额。
records.chart_reading: 4 项中最高是 Standard Class(343),其次 First Class(317),最低 Same Day(101),最高约为最低的 3.4 倍。按 总销售额 计,最高是 Standard Class(704,353.05)。
records.sql:
SELECT o.ship_mode AS 配送方式,
       COUNT(oi.row_id) AS 明细行数,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS 总销售额,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.sales) / (SELECT SUM(sales) FROM order_items), 1) AS 占比
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.ship_mode
ORDER BY 总销售额 DESC

records.question: 平均利润为负的商品子类有哪些?列出子类和平均利润。

       ROUND(AVG(oi.profit), 2) AS avg_profit

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category AS 子类, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS 总利润
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2014-12-31'
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING SUM(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY 总利润 DESC
